title: Restricted MDX compiler
responsibility: Compile a stage document to a renderable component at request time using `@mdx-js/mdx`, running the rejection plugin that fails the compile with a file path and a line:column position on any ESM import or export, JavaScript expression, JSX attribute expression, JSX spread attribute, or JSX element outside the permitted component set. Own the pinned compiler and plugin chain.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ REQUEST-TIME, NOT BUILD-TIME, AND THAT IS NOT A PERFORMANCE CHOICE. AST-0030 measured that a file-routed `@next/mdx` page is compiled into the build and does not reflect an edit, which REQ-0018 forbids. Routing stage documents as pages would satisfy REQ-0017 and silently fail REQ-0018 while looking correct. ⚠️ OUTSIDE ITS BOUNDARY: it does not read the document (that is the reader) and does not decide the component vocabulary (that is the mapping it is given). ⚠️ IT OWNS DEC-0020's PINNING OBLIGATION: changing the MDX version or adding any remark, rehype or recma plugin reopens security validation before it ships. The rejection was measured at the remark stage only; a later stage could reintroduce what it refused.
